## What Changes

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link a related issue when there is one.

## How It Works

Explain the implementation choices that help a reviewer understand the diff.

## Validation

List the checks you ran and their results. For interface changes, include phone-width light/dark screenshots and note keyboard or reduced-motion checks where relevant.

## Screenshots Or Example

Use invented journal entries for any reproduction or screenshot.

## Remaining Details

Mention a limitation or follow-up only if one remains.
